kind: Hand-authored demonstration fixture, not an external benchmark

documents.text: The CAN telemetry protocol sends throttle variation and brake usage in frame 0x300. Frame 0x301 carries energy consumption in Wh/km and regeneration efficiency. Frame 0x302 carries jerk.
Battery health estimation uses internal resistance, cycle count, depth of discharge, cell imbalance and coulombic efficiency. Training labels are synthetic.
Graph retrieval starts with vector search seeds and follows graph edges for two hops. Document scoped retrieval filters seeds and all neighboring nodes by document ID.
When image description generation fails, return an unavailable message. Do not insert invented chart values into retrieved evidence.

Retrieval evaluation uses relevance judgments. Precision counts relevant results among the requested k positions. Recall measures how many relevant documents were found. Reciprocal rank rewards an early first hit.
A reproducible experiment records a SHA256 hash of the corpus and relevance judgments. Export the dataset, parameters, software version and results together.
Food redistribution reservations use database transactions to prevent duplicate claims. Listings expire according to pickup deadlines and local zone rules.
A network monitor tracks WiFi signal, packet loss, latency and data usage. Captive portal authentication is separate from connection quality measurement.
BM25 ranks lexical document matches using term frequency saturation and document length normalization. TF-IDF cosine ranking normalizes document vectors and query vectors.
Embedded model export converts trained Random Forest classifiers to C++ headers. Verify feature ordering and units against the training CSV before running inference.

configuration.tokenizer: Unicode words, casefold, no stemming or stopword removal
